definitions.explanation: A style of sushi made by pressing a small mound of vinegared rice by hand and topping it with a slice of raw fish, seafood, or other ingredients. The most iconic form of sushi, originating in Edo (old Tokyo).

examples.japanese: {握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat nigiri sushi.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧でおいしい。
examples.english: The nigiri sushi at this restaurant is fresh and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The sushi chef made nigiri sushi right in front of us.

notes:
The most iconic form of sushi, made by pressing vinegared rice by hand and topping it with a slice of fish or seafood. Also called {握|にぎ}りずし or simply {握|にぎ}り.

COUNTING PATTERNS:
⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：17700_ikkan_b⟧、{二貫|にかん} — pieces are counted with ⟦{貫|かん}→貫：28717_kan⟧.

COMMON TOPPINGS (ネタ):
- {鮪|まぐろ}: tuna
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧/⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧: salmon
- ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧: shrimp
- ⟦{烏賊|いか}→烏賊：04319_ika⟧: squid
- {玉子|たまご}: egg

OTHER SUSHI TYPES:
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧: rolled sushi
- {散|ち}らし{寿司|ずし}: scattered sushi
- ⟦{押|お}し{寿司|ずし}→押し寿司：22489_oshizushi⟧: pressed sushi

CULTURAL NOTE:
Originated in the Edo period as a quick street food. Eating at a ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧ (conveyor belt sushi) restaurant is an affordable way to enjoy {握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}.
